[Previous context: It provides sub-loans to municipalities for investments in revenue-generating public services
and other high priority investment projects, as well as technical assistance grants for sub-project preparation, local capacity
building for municipalities and Communal Service Enterprises, and national level institutional strengthening.

Results achieved:

To date, 4 sub-projects have been completed.] The Municipality of Kočani has officially inaugurated a 6.4 km long section of the water supply system that was
rehabilitated with support from the Project. As a result, a total of 11,615 inhabitants in the municipality now benefit

from 24-hour regular water supply;

[Context: from 24-hour regular water supply;]
In Bogdanci, the population benefits from better and more energy efficient street lightning, cutting energy consumption
by more than 50 percent; The project entailed replacement of old mercury bulbs with new compact flouroscent light
bulbs. The project encompassed all inhabited areas. Total 8700 inhabitants will benefit from the project.
The city of Skopje procured equipment for street cleaning and new waste containers; 17 solid waste trucks and 60,000

waste bins have been purchased serving about 250,000 inhabitans

[Context: waste bins have been purchased serving about 250,000 inhabitans]
Solid Waste Management collection equipment was procured in the municipalities of Pehcevo, Vevčani, Kruševo, and

Kičevo serving a total of 43,500 inhabitants.
